title: Impact of molecular multimodality on neural network models for prediction tasks related to drug discovery
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 29 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74487-x

Here, the authors examine whether combining multiple molecular data types improves drug discovery models, finding multimodal approaches boost predictions with effective fusion, and even simple late-fusion methods can reach state-of-the-art performance.

title: Autonomous Motion Vision with Tri-bulk-heterojunctioned Organic Adaptation Transistor
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 29 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74905-0

Motion vision sensors typically perform motion analysis and moving-object extraction separately. Here, the authors develop an organic adaptation transistor that simultaneously extracts and analyses moving objects, achieving human-eye-like motion perception and improving safety in autonomous route-planning tasks.

title: Enhanced invasiveness promotes the dominance of a widely-distributed carbapenem-resistant virulence-plasmid-carrying Klebsiella pneumoniae sublineage
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 29 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74832-0

This long-term genomic surveillance identifies a widely disseminated carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae (CRKP) sublineage with enhanced invasiveness but no increased mortality, revealing immune evasion-driven spread and highlighting phage therapy as a potential intervention.

title: The structural mechanism of HIV-2 Vif antagonism of human APOBEC3H
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 29 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75045-1

HIV-2 Vif counteracts a broad range of APOBEC3 restriction factors to promote viral infectivity. Here, the authors determine the structure of HIV-2 Vif bound to human APOBEC3H and the host cofactor CBFβ, uncovering a distinct mode of APOBEC3H recognition and dimerization.

title: Development of efficient genetic toolkits and heterologous chassis for bioprospecting of myxobacteria
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 29 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74908-x

Myxobacteria are renowned producers of structurally diverse bioactive natural products but are difficult to engineer. Here the authors create a robust heterologous expression chassis and develop MxDIRECT, a recombineering strategy for scarless marker-free expression of biosynthetic gene clusters.

title: Accurate trajectory inference in time-series spatial transcriptomics with structurally-constrained optimal transport
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 29 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74927-8

Time-series spatial transcriptomics (ST) data can show dynamics of biological structures in situ. Here, the authors present an algorithm for cellular trajectory inference from time-series ST that leverages knowledge of spatially-coherent biological structures that develop as a unit.

title: Sialic acid-anchored haemagglutinin stalk neutralizing antibody M-SiaB enhances protection against highly pathogenic influenza H5N1/Texas/2024
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 29 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74633-5

Sialic acid-anchored bispecific broadly neutralizing antibody enhances protection against divergent influenza viruses including H5N1/Texas/2024 both in vitro and in vivo.
